item.title: Goat Life 0.2.0
item.description:
Your goat has a mind of its own now, and it mostly uses it to sit down.

  • A mind of its own. It decides what to do from how it feels and the time of day: grazing, sitting, watching you type, napping in the afternoon and sleeping through the night. Much less pacing.
  • A meadow on your Dock. It walks along the top of the Dock instead of over your icons, and grazes on a strip of grass at the far end. The patches it nibbles grow back.
  • Pet it. Stroke it with the pointer and it closes its eyes and blushes. A happy goat bounces, and now and then gets the zoomies.
  • Look after it as much as you like. A new Care setting: Self-sufficient (the default, gets its own water), Likes some attention, or Needs you, with Give Food and Give Water in the menu.
  • Bedtime. Control+G sends it to sleep behind your windows. Press it again and it wakes up with a stretch.
